title: Use a disclosure control to hide details until they’re relevant

statement.en: Use a disclosure control to hide details until they become relevant.
statement.ja: detailがrelevantになるまでdisclosure controlで隠す。

conditions: Use progressive disclosure to keep essential information easy to find without overwhelming people.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Disclosure controls experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDisclosure controlsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Use a disclosure control to hide details until they become relevant.” in the documented Disclosure controls context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Use a disclosure control to hide details until they become relevant.

apple_native_rule: Use a disclosure control to hide details until they become relevant.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.
